caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a metallic vessel or urn suspended by a U-shaped handle attached at two points near the vessel's widest part. The vessel itself is symmetrical, with a rounded body, a small lid or cap at the top, and a pedestal-like base that narrows downward. Below the base, the central supporting structure extends and terminates in an irregular, broken or unfinished edge. The color palette consists primarily of shades of brown, bronze, and muted gold, suggesting a metal surface with areas of light and shadow indicating curvature and depth. The background is an off-white or beige, and there are no additional objects or elements present except for some faint, vertical stains and a small area of text to the right of the vertical support.
title: Fireman's Torch
